item.title: 【Albums (lossless)】FLAC - Robbie Williams - BRITPOP (QUOBUZ 24Bit-44.1)
item.description:
On January 16, 2026, Robbie Williams released his thirteenth studio album, titled "BRITPOP". The record serves as a sonic homage to the 1990s musical movement and marks his first release of entirely original material in nearly a decade.

The album's release was strategically moved to January 2026 to avoid a chart clash with Taylor Swift's late-2025 release. With this album, Williams aims to break his tie with The Beatles for the most Number 1 albums in the UK (both currently hold 15).
To support the release, Williams is embarking on the "Long 90's Tour" beginning in February 2026. The tour consists of intimate residency shows in Glasgow, Liverpool, Wolverhampton, and London, where he performs the BRITPOP album in its entirety alongside his 1997 debut, Life Thru a Lens.
